x-k-k3-01.title: Ubani onikeze imali yokuzisebenzisa?
x-k-k3-01.goal: Phetha ukuthi isihloko esishiyiwe sibhekisela kubani, khomba ubufakazi embhalweni, bese usho ukuthi isiphetho sishintsha kanjani uma inkomba eyodwa isuswa.
x-k-k3-01.material:
Abafundi ababili abafunda nabo, 지우 no-하나, baxoxa ngesiKorea esinenhlonipho se--요. IsiKorea sivame ukushiya isihloko (ubani owenza isenzo). (댁 = igama elihloniphekile lekhaya lomuntu.)

지우: 어제 뭐 했어요?
하나: 할머니 댁에 갔어요. 맛있는 밥을 먹었어요. 용돈도 주셨어요.
지우: 좋았겠어요!
x-k-k3-01.prereq.1: Usukubonile ukuphela kwe--요 namagama 할머니, 친구, 용돈
x-k-k3-01.s.s1.prompt: Ubani onikeze 하나 imali yokuzisebenzisa (용돈도 주셨어요)?
x-k-k3-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bheka ukuphela kuka-주셨어요 uqhathanise no-먹었어요 emugqeni ongaphambi kwawo.
x-k-k3-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala wonke umuntu ovela emishweni emithathu ka-하나.
x-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.a: Yena owamukele imali, futhi isenzo esihlonipha owenzayo asisetshenziselwa ngokwakhe.
x-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.c: 지우 ubuza kuphela futhi aphendule; akukho lutho embhalweni oluthi unikeze noma yini.
x-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.d: Ifomu lesenzo likhomba umuntu amhloniphayo, hhayi umfundi wobudala obufanayo.
x-k-k3-01.s.s1.explain: Umbhalo awuqambi isihloko, kodwa ifomu lesenzo likhombisa ukuthi onikezayo ungumuntu okufanele ahlonishwe, futhi kuphela umuntu onjalo endabeni ngu-할머니, okuyikhaya lakhe 하나 alivakashele. 'Cishe' kulungile: umbhalo awusho ngokuqondile.
x-k-k3-01.s.s2.prompt: Yiziphi izingcezu zobufakazi ezisekela impendulo yakho? Khetha zonke ezisebenzayo.
x-k-k3-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kunketho ngayinye buza: ingitshela UBANI, noma KUPHELA ini?
x-k-k3-01.s.s2.hint.1: Thola inkomba mayelana nesenzo nenkomba mayelana nendawo.
x-k-k3-01.s.s2.o.a: U-용돈 usho imali yokuzisebenzisa, ngakho onikezayo kumele abe wasemndenini.
x-k-k3-01.s.s2.r.a: Igama liqamba okunikeziwe, hhayi ukuthi ubani onikezile.
x-k-k3-01.s.s2.o.b: U-맛있는 밥 ukhombisa ukuthi onikezayo naye upheke ukudla.
x-k-k3-01.s.s2.r.b: Ukudla nemali yizenzo ezehlukile; akukho lutho oluxhuma kokubili nomuntu oyedwa.
x-k-k3-01.s.s2.o.d: 하나 wayesanda kuba sekhaya lika-할머니 futhi akekho omunye oqanjiwe lapho.
x-k-k3-01.s.s2.explain: Izinkomba ezimbili zisebenza ndawonye: ifomu lesenzo litshela ukuthi onikezayo uhlobo luni lomuntu, futhi indaba itshela ukuthi ubani ukhona. Imali yokuzisebenzisa nokudla akusho lutho ngonikezayo.
x-k-k3-01.s.s2.acc.0: Ifomu lesenzo yinkomba eqinile kunazo zonke; u-d wengeza ukuthi umongo wendaba uyafana.
x-k-k3-01.s.s3.prompt: Cabanga ukuthi 하나 ubethe '용돈도 줬어요' esikhundleni sika-'용돈도 주셨어요'. Kushintsha ini?
x-k-k3-01.s.s3.hint.0: Susa inkomba evela ku-s2 oyithole iqinile kakhulu ubone ukuthi kusala ini.
x-k-k3-01.s.s3.r.a: Ifomu elihloniphayo bekuyinye yezinkomba ezincishisa onikezayo; ngaphandle kwalo inkomba iyanyamalala.
x-k-k3-01.s.s3.o.b: Onikezayo manje angaba umngane noma umuntu omncane nakho.
x-k-k3-01.s.s3.r.c: Akukho lutho embhalweni olukhomba 지우 noma ngayiphi indlela.
x-k-k3-01.s.s3.r.d: U-'줬어요' umusho ojwayelekile onenhlonipho; uphethe ulwazi oluncane nje ngonikezayo.
x-k-k3-01.s.s3.explain: Ngaphandle kwefomu elihloniphayo indaba isafana no-할머니, kodwa ayisaqinisi ukungafaki abanye abantu. Ukuzethemba kwakho empendulweni yokuqala kufanele kwehle.

x-k-k3-02.title: Umugqa owodwa ongajwayelekile ekuziethuleni
x-k-k3-02.goal: Thola umugqa ekuziethuleni ozwakala ungajwayelekile, sho ukuthi kungani, bese uwubhala kabusha ukuze uzwakale wemvelo.
x-k-k3-02.material: Umfundi omusha, 이민수, uyazethula ekilasini. Imigqa emihlanu iyakhonjiswa. Umugqa owodwa uzwakala ungajwayelekile kumlaleli waseKorea.
x-k-k3-02.s.s1.hint.0: Funda umugqa ngamunye ngokuvakalayo sengathi ukhuluma nekilasi lakho. Yimuphi ongenza abalaleli bamamathe?
x-k-k3-02.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 2 awujwayelekile. U-님 isihloko esengezwa emagameni abanye abantu ukukhombisa inhlonipho. Ukukubeka egameni lakho kuzwakala sengathi uyazidumisa. Eminye imigqa ilungile ekuziethuleni ekilasini.
x-k-k3-02.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi wengeza nini u-님: 선생님? 친구? wena?
x-k-k3-02.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa nendlela umugqa 3 ukhuluma ngayo ngomkhulumi.
x-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.a: Isihloko esikhombisa inhlonipho sinamathiselwe egameni likamkhulumi.
x-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.b: Amagama angalandelwa nge-은/는 kuphela, hhayi nge-이에요.
x-k-k3-02.s.s2.r.b: U-이에요 ngemuva kwegama yindlela ejwayelekile yokusho 'Ngingu-___'; lokhu akuyona inkinga.
x-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.c: Ukuziethula kumele kusebenzise u-입니다, hhayi u-이에요.
x-k-k3-02.s.s2.r.c: Kokubili kunenhlonipho; umugqa 5 usebenzisa u-습니다 futhi umugqa 1 usebenzisa u-요, futhi ukuxuba kujwayelekile.
x-k-k3-02.s.s2.r.d: Ukunika igama eliphelele kujwayelekile; ingxenye engemuva kwegama yiyona nkinga.
x-k-k3-02.s.s2.explain: Isihloko u-님 sokukhombisa inhlonipho komunye umuntu. Sebenzisa igama lakho ngaphandle kwaso.
x-k-k3-02.s.s3.prompt: Bhala kabusha umugqa 2 ukuze uzwakale wemvelo. Wubhale ngesiKorea ngesitayela esinenhlonipho.
x-k-k3-02.s.s3.hint.0: Gcina u-이민수 njengegama futhi usho 'igama lami ngu-...' noma 'Ngingu-...'.
x-k-k3-02.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuphela komusho wakho: kufanele kusenhlonipho (요 noma 습니다).

x-k-k3-03.title: Kusukela embhalweni womngane kuya embhalweni kagogo
x-k-k3-03.topic: Izihloko namazinga okukhuluma: ukubhalela umzali omdala
x-k-k3-03.goal: Nquma ukuthi yiziphi izingxenye zomlayezo ongajwayelekile okumele zishintshe ugogo, bese uwubhala kabusha ngamafomu anenhlonipho namagama afanele athi 'mina', 'wena' nekhaya.
x-k-k3-03.material:
하나 uthumele lokhu kumngane osondele:

나 내일 학교 끝나고 너네 집에 가. 같이 밥 먹어.

(나 = mina, 너네 집 = ikhaya lomndeni wakho, 가 no-먹어 kuphela okungajwayelekile.) Ufuna ukuthumela izindaba cishe ezifanayo kugogo wakhe 할머니, ozovakashela indlu yakhe kusasa.
x-k-k3-03.thinking.1: Ukukhetha amafomu anenhlonipho eceleni lomuntu nelomunye
x-k-k3-03.s.s1.prompt: Yiziphi izingxenye zomlayezo womngane okumele zishintshe ugogo 할머니? Khetha zonke ezisebenzayo.
x-k-k3-03.s.s1.hint.0: Buza: uma ngifaka u-할머니 esikhundleni somngane, yimaphi amagama asafanela?
x-k-k3-03.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola izinhlobo ezintathu zamagama: 'mina', 'ikhaya lakho', nendlela imisho eyaphela ngayo.
x-k-k3-03.s.s1.r.a: Le ngxenye iqamba isikhathi futhi ayincikile ekutheni ubani olalelayo.
x-k-k3-03.s.s1.explain: Igama elithi 'mina', igama lekhaya lomunye umuntu nokuphela kwemisho konke kuncike kumlaleli. Ibinzana lesikhathi alincikile.
x-k-k3-03.s.s2.prompt: Bhala kabusha umlayezo ku-할머니 ngesiKorea. Qala ngokumbiza ngokuthi 할머니.
x-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.0: Sebenzisa igama elithobekile elithi 'mina' nokuphela okunenhlonipho.
x-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.1: Shintsha u-너네 집 ngebinzana eliqamba umuntu ozilungele indlu.
x-k-k3-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Isebenzisa u-집 no-밥, avumelekile kuleli zinga.

x-k-k3-05.title: Wawuzocela ini ku-민호 ukuze uthole?
x-k-k3-05.goal: Nquma ukuthi incazelo emfushane yomndeni iyanela yini ukuphendula umbuzo, thola ucezu olushodayo, bese ulucela ngombuzo wesiKorea onenhlonipho.

민호 wabhala:

저는 열 살이에요. 우리 가족은 다섯 명이에요. 할머니, 아버지, 어머니, 누나, 그리고 저예요. 누나는 저보다 나이가 많아요.

Ufuna ukwazi ngokunembile ukuthi u-누나 uneminyaka emingaki.

x-k-k3-07.topic: Ubudlelwano: amagama omndeni encike ekutheni ngubani okhulumayo
x-k-k3-07.goal: Thola igama lomndeni elingahambisani nomkhulumi, khetha igama elifanele, bese uhlola ukuthi kushintsha ini uma umkhulumi engomunye umuntu.
x-k-k3-07.material: U-하나 uyintombazane. Unomfowabo omdala oyedwa (oneminyaka eyi-15) nodadewabo omdala oyedwa (oneminyaka eyi-17). Wethula umndeni wakhe ekilasini lakhe.
x-k-k3-07.thinking.0: Ukuthola igama eliyinqaba usebenzisa ulwazi mayelana nomkhulumi
x-k-k3-07.thinking.2: Ukuhlola ukuthi ushintsho lomkhulumi lushintsha kanjani isinqumo
x-k-k3-07.prereq.1: Wazi ukuthi isiKorea sinegama elingaphezu kwelilodwa lomfowabo omdala nodadewabo omdala
x-k-k3-07.s.s1.prompt: Ngumuphi umugqa onegama lomndeni elingahambisani no-하나?
x-k-k3-07.s.s1.hint.0: Phawula ukuthi ubani umfana noma intombazane endabeni. Yiwaphi amagama omndeni encike kulokho?
x-k-k3-07.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa imigqa emibili eqamba umfowabo noma udadewabo omdala.
x-k-k3-07.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 uyinqaba. Intombazane ibiza umfowabo omdala ngokuthi 오빠, hhayi 형. Umfana angasebenzisa 형. Umugqa 4 ulungile ngoba intombazane ibiza udadewabo omdala ngokuthi 언니.
x-k-k3-07.s.s2.prompt: Yiliphi igama okufanele lithathe indawo ka-형 emgqeni 3?
x-k-k3-07.s.s2.hint.0: Ingabe umuntu mdala noma mncane kuno-하나?
x-k-k3-07.s.s2.r.a: U-누나 yigama umfana alisebenzisa kudadewabo omdala; lapha umfowabo umfowabo.
x-k-k3-07.s.s2.r.b: U-동생 usho umfowabo omncane noma udadewabo omncane, kodwa uneminyaka eyi-15 futhi mdala kuno-하나.
x-k-k3-07.s.s2.explain: Intombazane ibiza umfowabo omdala ngokuthi 오빠. Umugqa uba ngu-우리 오빠는 열다섯 살이에요.
x-k-k3-07.s.s3.prompt: Manje cabanga ukuthi u-하나 ungumfana onomndeni ofanayo (umfowabo omdala oyedwa nodadewabo omdala oyedwa). Yimiphi imigqa edinga ukushintshwa?
x-k-k3-07.s.s3.hint.0: Hlola umugqa 3 nomugqa 4 ngokwehlukana nomkhulumi omusha.
x-k-k3-07.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala igama elilungile lomfana kumfowabo noma udadewabo ngamunye.
x-k-k3-07.s.s3.r.b: Kumfana u-형 yigama elilungile, ngakho umugqa 3 ubuyoba nokulunga.
x-k-k3-07.s.s3.r.c: Elilodwa kuphela lawo magama amabili elingeke lihambisane.
x-k-k3-07.s.s3.r.d: Hlola igama ngalinye ngokumelene nomkhulumi omusha.
x-k-k3-07.s.s3.explain: Kumfana u-형 (umfowabo omdala) ulungile, kodwa udadewabo omdala ngu-누나, hhayi u-언니. Ngakho umugqa 4 uyoshintsha.

x-k-k3-08.title: Ungakhuluma ngokungasemthethweni nomndeni?
x-k-k3-08.goal: Hlulela isimangalo mayelana nokukhuluma namalungu omndeni, uthole ukuthi yiziphi izingxenye ezibambekile nezingabambeki, bese ubhala umusho owodwa womfowenu noma udadewenu nomunye kagogo noma umkhulu.
x-k-k3-08.material:
Abangani ababili baxoxa ngendlela yokukhuluma nomndeni.

하나: 가족한테는 항상 반말을 써도 돼. 우리 가족이잖아.
준: 아니야. 할머니한테 '밥 먹었어?' 하면 안 돼.
(반말 = ukukhuluma okungasemthethweni ngaphandle kwe--요 enenhlonipho.)
(Amagama ahloniphayo okudla: 드시다, 진지, 식사하시다.)
x-k-k3-08.thinking.1: Ukubona ukuthi isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo siphula u-'njalo' kodwa hhayi u-'kwesinye isikhathi'
x-k-k3-08.prereq.2: Ungasebenzisa amagama ahloniphayo 드시다, 진지, 식사하시다 kogogo noma umkhulu
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.prompt: Yiziphi izitatimende ezifanele ngale mpikiswano? Khetha zonke ezisebenzayo.
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.hint.0: Isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo sizobonisani, futhi singabonisani?
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi umuntu uvame ukukhuluma nobani ngokungasemthethweni ekhaya.
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.o.a: U-'항상' unamandla kakhulu: isibonelo esisodwa njengo-할머니 sanele ukubuza ngawo.
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.o.b: Imindeni iyahluka: eminye isebenzisa ukukhuluma okungasemthethweni nabazali, eminye cha, ngakho akukho mthetho owodwa ofanele yonke imindeni.
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.o.c: Amalungu omndeni asondelene, ngakho akudingeki ukucabanga ngenhlonipho ekhaya.
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.r.c: Lokhu kuphinda isimangalo ka-하나 esikhundleni sokusihlola.
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.o.d: Isibonelo sika-준 sibonisa ukuthi ukukhuluma okungasemthethweni namalungu omndeni akulungile.
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.r.d: Isibonelo esisodwa ngo-할머니 asimboleli umfowenu omncane noma yonke imindeni; siphula kuphela u-'njalo'.
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.explain: Isimangalo esithi 'njalo ngokungasemthethweni' siphulwa isibonelo esisodwa esiphikisayo, kodwa lokho akusho 'akukaze'. Imindeni yangempela iyahluka, futhi ubudlelwano bunquma.
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.acc.0: Ukubona ubuthakathaka bo-'항상' kuyiphuzu eliyinhloko; u-b wengeza ukuthi imindeni iyahluka.
x-k-k3-08.s.s2.prompt: Bhala imibuzo emibili emifushane yesiKorea ebuza ukuthi umuntu udlile yini: owodwa komfowenu omncane nomunye kogogo noma umkhulu wakho.
x-k-k3-08.s.s2.hint.0: Sebenzisa isiphetho esingasemthethweni komfowenu omncane. Kogogo noma umkhulu sebenzisa isiphetho esinenhlonipho neyodwa yamagama ahloniphayo e-'eat' enothini elingenhla.
x-k-k3-08.s.s2.hint.1: Faka u-할머니 noma u-할아버지 emshweni wesibili.
x-k-k3-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ngisebenzise iziphetho ezihlukile kubantu ababili?

x-k-k3-10.title: Chaza ilungu lomndeni ukuze oyedwa kuphela afanele
x-k-k3-10.goal: Thola ukuthi yiliphi ipheya lenkomba likhomba ilungu lomndeni elilodwa kuphela, bese ubhala ipheya lakho lenkomba lelinye ilungu.
x-k-k3-10.material:
Umndeni ka-민수 (bonke bahlala endlini efanayo):

민수 (iminyaka engu-12, umfana)
남동생 (8, umfana)
누나 (15, intombazane)
아버지 (45)
어머니 (42)
할머니 (70, unina luka-아버지)

Ipheya lenkomba incazelo yomuntu oyedwa, yomdlalo wokuqagela.

x-k-k3-10.thinking.2: Ukwenza ipheya lenkomba elifanelana nomuntu oyedwa kuphela

x-k-k3-10.s.s1.prompt: Yiliphi ipheya lenkomba likhomba umuntu oyedwa kuphela?
x-k-k3-10.s.s1.hint.0: Hlola ipheya lenkomba kumuntu ngamunye ohlwini, oyedwa ngaoyedwa.
x-k-k3-10.s.s1.hint.1: Bala ukuthi bangaki abantu abafanelana nepheya ngalinye.
x-k-k3-10.s.s1.r.a: Lokhu kufanelana ne-누나, 어머니 ne-할머니, ngakho akukhethi umuntu oyedwa.
x-k-k3-10.s.s1.explain: Ngu-아버지 kuphela indoda endala kuno-민수. Amanye amapheya ashiya abantu ababili noma abathathu.
x-k-k3-10.s.s2.prompt: Khetha 누나, 남동생 noma 할머니 bese ubhala imisho emibili yenkomba yesiKorea efanelana nalowo muntu kuphela. Sebenzisa izinkomba ezinhle kuphela (ngaphandle kwe-아니에요 / 안), futhi ungasebenzisi igama lalowo muntu (누나, 동생, 할머니).
x-k-k3-10.s.s2.hint.0: Hlanganisa izinhlobo ezimbili zezinkomba, njenge-남자/여자 nokuqhathanisa iminyaka noma inani leminyaka.
x-k-k3-10.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola imisho yakho emibili kubo bonke abantu abathandathu ngaphambi kokuqeda.
x-k-k3-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ipheya lami lenkomba lifanelana nomuntu oyedwa kuphela uma ngihlola bonke abathandathu?
x-k-k3-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngigwemile igama lomuntu (누나, 동생 noma 할머니)?
x-k-k3-10.s.s2.modelNote.3: Inkomba ngayinye yodwa ifanelana ne-할머니 kuphela.

x-k-k3-09.title: Umndeni ungaba neminyaka emingaki?
x-k-k3-09.goal: Funda izinkomba zeminyaka ngesiKorea, ubone ukuthi zishiya amathuba amaningi, bese wakha imindeni ehlukene eyanelisa zonke izinkomba.
x-k-k3-09.material:
민수 uchaza umndeni wakhe:

저는 12살이에요.
형은 저보다 2살이나 3살 많아요.
아버지는 형보다 28살에서 32살 많아요.
할머니는 아버지보다 25살에서 32살 많아요.
할머니는 75살보다 어려요.

(Yonke iminyaka iyizinombolo eziphelele.)
